title: CFA Institute Research Challenge Presentation Scoring Sheet (2017 published form)

criteria.name: Financial Analysis
criteria.official_prompt: How thorough was their analysis of the industry, company, and competitors?

criteria.name: Valuation
criteria.official_prompt: Were the valuation methodologies appropriate and detailed?

criteria.name: Presentation
criteria.official_prompt: How effective/convincing was their presentation? Was it logical and did the facts support the recommendation?

criteria.name: Question & Answer
criteria.official_prompt: Were they able to answer the questions effectively and with confidence?

criteria.name: Team Involvement
criteria.official_prompt: Team involvement in the presentation/questions and answers

sources.title: Appendix E — Presentation Scoring Sheet
sources.evidence: Official published form assigns 25/25/20/20/5/5 and does not contain a separate ESG presentation criterion.

provenance.applicability_note: The source establishes the form published in December 2017. It does not establish exact start and end seasons across all historical benchmark entries.
